# 国策图、前置关系与返回句柄

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

用 `FocusGraph` 声明一个由命名节点组成的完整国策图。`nodes` 的键是编译期引用，输出 ID 由树的 `prefix` 与节点键组合而成；改变节点排列不会改变 ID。返回对象的 `focuses` 可传给国家作用域的完成国策检查和效果。

把解锁条件写在节点自己的 `requires` 中：`f => f.charter` 要求一个前置，`{ all: [...] }` 要求全部完成，`{ any: [...] }` 接受任意一个；可以嵌套组合。`exclusiveWith` 选择互斥节点，编译器自动建立对称关系。`FocusNodes` 定义可复用节点模块，展开后仍保留精确名称和上下文类型。

图会检查不存在的节点、环、空分组和无法满足的互斥前置。布局缺省值根据图的依赖深度生成；需要对齐已有原生树或共享国策时，可使用 [FocusTree](focus-trees.md) 提供精确位置和原生前置分组。

## 使用示例

```ts
import { FocusGraph } from "krieg-lang/hoi4";

export const recovery = FocusGraph({
  id: "recovery", prefix: "REC",
  nodes: {
    charter: { cost: 3 },
    industry: { requires: f => f.charter, cost: 5, completionReward: c => c.effects.addPoliticalPower(50) },
    relief: { requires: f => f.charter, cost: 5 },
  },
});
```

## FocusGraph() { #focusgraph }

> **FocusGraph**&lt;`Id` *extends* `string`, `Key` *extends* `string`, `Prefix` *extends* `string` = `Id`&gt;(`spec`: [`FocusGraphSpec`](#focusgraphspec)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt;): [`FocusGraphDefinition`](#focusgraphdefinition)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:246](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L246)

Build a complete focus graph from gameplay nodes and their local requirements.

### Type Parameters { #focusgraph-section-type-parameters }

| Type Parameter | Default type |
| ------ | ------ |
| <a id="focusgraph-type-parameter-id"></a> `Id` *extends* `string` | - |
| <a id="focusgraph-type-parameter-key"></a> `Key` *extends* `string` | - |
| <a id="focusgraph-type-parameter-prefix"></a> `Prefix` *extends* `string` | `Id` |

### Parameters { #focusgraph-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `spec` | [`FocusGraphSpec`](#focusgraphspec)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt; |

### Returns { #focusgraph-section-returns }

[`FocusGraphDefinition`](#focusgraphdefinition)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt;

### Remarks { #focusgraph-section-remarks }

Rejects missing nodes, cycles, empty groups, and unavoidable mutually
exclusive prerequisites. Generated IDs are stable under node reordering. Use
the returned `focuses` references with `country.hasCompletedFocus` and
`country.completeFocus`. External/shared-focus graphs use the lower-level
FocusTree API, because this graph deliberately describes a closed DAG.

### Example { #focusgraph-section-example }

```ts
const tree = FocusGraph({
  id: "reconstruction", prefix: "REC",
  nodes: {
    charter: { cost: 3 },
    industry: {
      requires: f => f.charter, exclusiveWith: f => f.relief,
      cost: 5, completionReward: c => c.effects.addPoliticalPower(50),
    },
    relief: { requires: f => f.charter, cost: 5 },
    assembly: { requires: f => ({ any: [f.industry, f.relief] }), cost: 5 },
  },
});
```


## FocusGraphSpec&lt;Id *extends* `string`, Key *extends* `string`, Prefix *extends* `string` = `Id`&gt; { #focusgraphspec }

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:198](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L198)

A focus tree with topology checked against the exact keys of `nodes`.

### Remarks { #focusgraphspec-section-remarks }

Node-local requirements generate native prerequisite groups. Each choice
group creates pairwise, symmetric mutual exclusions. Defaults position nodes
by dependency depth, with columns assigned in declaration order within a row.

## FocusNodeSpec { #focusnodespec }

## FocusNodes() { #focusnodes }

> **FocusNodes**&lt;`Key` *extends* `string`&gt;(`nodes`: [`FocusNodeSet`](#focusnodeset)&lt;`Key`&gt;): [`FocusNodeSet`](#focusnodeset)&lt;`Key`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:177](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L177)

Define a reusable, typed collection of focus nodes without emitting a tree.

### Type Parameters { #focusnodes-section-type-parameters }

| Type Parameter |
| ------ |
| <a id="focusnodes-type-parameter-key"></a> `Key` *extends* `string` |

### Returns { #focusnodes-section-returns }

### Remarks { #focusnodes-section-remarks }

Spread the returned nodes into one or more FocusGraphs. Internal
selectors are checked here; graph-level selectors also see the imported nodes.
Each consuming graph supplies its own ID prefix and layout. A module owns its
node names; use distinct names when combining modules in the same tree.

### Remarks { #focusrequirement-section-remarks }

Nested groups retain their boolean meaning. The compiler distributes
OR over AND to produce the game's prerequisite blocks, with a checked limit
on expansion. This describes accumulated completed focuses, not a state machine.
